Add a bold panel letter (a, b, c...) matching journal house style

Source: R/export.R
labs_panel.Rd

Prefer [olinkviz_combine()] for multi-panel figures (whose `journal` argument sets panel tags automatically, including the right case and point size); this helper tags a single ggplot.

Usage

labs_panel(label, size = NULL, journal = NULL)

Arguments

label

Panel letter. Without `journal` it is used as written; with `journal` it is converted to that journal's case (`"lower"` for Nature, `"upper"` for Cell Press, Science, PNAS, PLOS, JID).

size

Font size in pt. `NULL` (default) uses the journal's panel-tag size when `journal` is given and 10 pt otherwise.

journal

Optional registered journal id (see [journal_specs()]) whose panel-tag case and size to use.

Value

A list of ggplot layers / theme elements to add with `+`.

See also

Other export: olinkviz_combine(), save_olinkviz()

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_journal("nature") +
  labs_panel("a", journal = "nature")
